<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Dapplo.Language</id>
    <version>0.6.2</version>
    <authors>Dapplo</authors>
    <owners>Dapplo</owners>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>false</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <licenseUrl>http://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.en.html</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>http://www.dapplo.net/blocks/Dapplo.Config/</projectUrl>
    <iconUrl>http://www.dapplo.net/favicon.ico</iconUrl>
    <description>Dapplo.Language uses xml or ini translations which are accessible via an interface (with NPC).</description>
    <copyright>Copyright © Dapplo 2016-2018</copyright>
    <tags>dapplo language config</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/dapplo/Dapplo.Config" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETFramework4.6.1">
        <dependency id="Dapplo.InterfaceImpl" version="0.3.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Dapplo.Log" version="1.3.11" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Dapplo.Utils" version="1.1.3" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
    <frameworkAssemblies>
      <frameworkAssembly assemblyName="System.Xml" targetFramework=".NETFramework4.6.1" />
      <frameworkAssembly assemblyName="System.Xml.Linq" targetFramework=".NETFramework4.6.1" />
    </frameworkAssemblies>
  </metadata>
</package>
